Based on the state each female legislator first represented, which state has the highest number of female legislators whose terms included December 31st at any point, and what is that count? Please provide the state's abbreviation.

args.sql:
SELECT 
    l.id_bioguide,
    l.gender,
    t.term_start,
    t.term_end,
    t.state
FROM city_legislation.main.legislators l
JOIN city_legislation.main.legislators_terms t ON l.id_bioguide = t.id_bioguide
WHERE l.gender = 'F'
ORDER BY l.id_bioguide, t.term_start
LIMIT 12;

WITH female_legislators AS (
    SELECT 
        l.id_bioguide,
        t.state,
        t.term_start,
        t.term_end,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY l.id_bioguide ORDER BY t.term_start ASC) as rn
    FROM city_legislation.main.legislators l
    JOIN city_legislation.main.legislators_terms t ON l.id_bioguide = t.id_bioguide
    WHERE l.gender = 'F'
),
first_states AS (
    SELECT id_bioguide, state as first_state
    FROM female_legislators
    WHERE rn = 1
),
dec_31_flags AS (
    SELECT 
        id_bioguide,
        MAX(CASE WHEN term_end >= CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM term_start::DATE) AS VARCHAR) || '-12-31' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_dec_31
    FROM female_legislators
    GROUP BY id_bioguide
)
SELECT 
    fs.first_state,
    COUNT(*) as count
FROM first_states fs
JOIN dec_31_flags d ON fs.id_bioguide = d.id_bioguide
WHERE d.has_dec_31 = 1
GROUP BY fs.first_state
ORDER BY count DESC
LIMIT 5;
